_comment_thresholds: Absolute token counts, NOT a percentage of the context window. Derived from a 6-session personal corpus of coding-heavy work on 1M-context models (Opus 4.8/5, Sonnet 5). These are a v1 default, not a universal constant - if you run a 200k-window model, lower them or they can never fire.
_comment_nudge: Phase 2. Suggest-only: v1 never runs /compact itself, it tells Claude what the sensor sees and lets Claude decide. A nudge fires once on ENTERING a level, not once per turn - 60% of turns in the validation corpus sat above the warn line, so per-turn firing would nag continuously.
_comment_scratchpad: Paths excluded from repeat-read counting. Phase 0 found 33% of repeat-read events were the agent polling its own background-task output - correct behaviour, not confusion. Patterns use fnmatch semantics against a lowercased forward-slash path, so '*' crosses separators.
